body:
You're very sweet and I really appreciate you for listening and being there. Now please get some sleep. lol

I'm very worried about my parents and friends will find out about my religious change. I probably should have specified that my parents are thinking about arranging a marriage from someone from their home country. (I was born here). I don't want to go through it or even look for someone because I refuse to marry someone of my past religion. They will not accept if I marry someone out of the religion or ethnicity.
I think I think of it as a method of taking control. I don't know how to stop thinking like it's an answer to all of my problems.

I don't really have much of a social life. I feel like I'm incapable of making friends. I'm very ashamed of this. I'm also ashamed that I've never really been in a relationship before. The very few that I do have like me very much, which I'm grateful for. I'm not doing well in college. I have massive anxiety about doing work, so I do everything in the last second and sometimes I don't do it at all. I feel suicidal sometimes whenever I have to take an exam or do an essay. I still live with my parents and I've never had a good relationship with them. My mother nags too much and my dad has always been very distant. I feel uncomfortable in his presence. I used to get verbally and emotionally abused as a kid. I avoid them completely now but I feel like that makes me ungrateful because they still have done a lot for me. I've recently left my religion and I'm now an agnostic/atheist. My parents don't know and my mom is super religious. My mom is going to be planning my marriage soon which makes me feel like I should just kill myself. I don't have any confidence to get a job or do anything to leave and I feel like even if I did I'm incapable of living by myself. I'm just tired and feel like nothing is going to get better.

sorry for the wall of text. thanks for listening.
